insight: There's been no rain at all lately, so there's no runoff driving contamination, and strong summer sunlight is helping disinfect the water. The last lab sample (5 MPN/100mL) is now 8 days old — beaches are sampled about weekly, so a reading this stale carries little weight, and this estimate leans on current conditions.
